rl_requirement: The selected strategy must load a trained Stable-Baselines3 SAC checkpoint. Safety layers may bound unsafe commands but must pass the declared SAC action-authority thresholds.
intervention_definition: The hazard-supervisor intervention rate excludes the separately disclosed speed-governor projection rate. The combined raw-action modification rate remains disclosed and is constrained indirectly by the raw SAC acceptance and RL authority thresholds.
claim_boundary: Offline historical-public-data and counterfactual-simulation evidence only; not field acceptance or live-vessel control authority.
